t2.thesis: While rock-bottom sentiment, 52-week lows, and positive call skew set up an attractive relief-rally threshold, persistent traffic headwinds from the August salmonella scare and margin contraction keep the probability only slightly above even.
reasons: CMG shares trade at 52-week lows after a 12% one-month drop and multiple analyst downgrades, sharply resetting expectations heading into the print.
August food safety disclosures and Q2 10-Q commentary noted emerging low-single-digit comp headwinds and margin pressure from beef and wage inflation.
Option market pricing reflects upside call skew (call IV 8.1 pts higher than put IV and low P/C volume of 0.41), pointing to speculative upside positioning against heavy put hedging.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 comparable restaurant sales trajectory and management commentary on whether foot traffic rebounded entering Q4 following the August food safety incident.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down from the 0.555 consumer cluster prior to 0.520 due to documented traffic disruption from the August salmonella scare and ongoing restaurant-level margin compression, offset partially by an oversold technical setup.

theses.expected: Relief rally on in-line comps and margin resilience
theses.mechanism: With the stock down 32% over 12 months and forward P/E compressed to ~20.5x, even modest comp growth (1-2%) and stable Q4 guidance prompt short covering and multiple expansion.
theses.wrong_if: Comp sales turned sharply negative in Q3 or guidance for the full year is cut below low-single digits.

theses.mechanism: Salmonella-related consumer hesitation lingered through September and October, compounding beef cost inflation and forcing management to lower full-year guidance.
theses.wrong_if: The return of Smoked Brisket and Chipotle Rewards initiatives successfully re-accelerated traffic in late Q3.

theses.mechanism: Results match expectations precisely with flat year-over-year EPS ($0.29), leading to an IV crush with little net directional movement between entry and exit opens.
theses.wrong_if: Management delivers a substantial surprise on store margins or international unit expansion.

key_observations: Q3 comparable restaurant sales (comp) percentage versus low-single-digit guidance
Restaurant-level operating margin impact from beef and packaging inflation
Impact and customer recovery timeline following the August jalapeño salmonella investigation
Q4 commentary on the promotional launch of Smoked Brisket
t2.method: D004 v4: leak-probe call without the dossier, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; no tools
